scope: SYNTHETIC ONLY: a regression gate for this repo's seeded generator, not a claim about real fraud performance.
baseline_source: CI run 45093948824 on main (commit 3f14900): xgboost test PR-AUC 0.765, ROC-AUC 0.941, recall at validation-FPR threshold 0.8125, ECE 0.063, realised FPR 0.094 on 144 rows with 16 positives.
tolerance_note: Floors sit about one positive case below the recorded baseline (16 test positives, so one miss moves recall by 0.0625) to absorb library-version drift while still failing a broken model.
